exit_criteria.text: While a pull request loads or its comparisons are unavailable, the readiness words appear in the Updates line's track when it is open and in the review bar's summary when it is folded, in every modality. BPR-0795's readiness row is gone, the window course no longer allows reviewReadiness between the title row, the review bar and the open timeline, and the height floors hold open and folded, loading and loaded.

The review bar reads file navigation before change navigation, as AC-03 is amended, at every scale and at the width floor, and the focus order follows the visual order. The window rows and the UIforETW capture's 14-action order in all four appearance profiles assert it, and any composition pin the change touches is resealed with its recorded review.

Why the frozen candidate's Compose review showed the invalidated-authority state is established. In every state it can be in, the Compose review page says what it is, what state the draft is in and what to do next, and every unavailable action says why.

The second tray tab is Notes, as decided on BPR-1204 under the owner's delegation after his direction on its purpose. Its label, tooltip, accessible names, the action that selects it and its empty state say it is the reviewer's private space for non-public notes and AI conversations and review feedback; it shows whether or not an agent is configured, and it holds no thread's controls and no Dif. The workbench specification and the window, focus-order, accessibility and composed courses that named Findings follow Notes, with a negative control.

On a tab over an older pair the Comments tray lists only the threads of the tab's revisions, its notice names how many are on later updates, and Show them reaches them. A current-head tab shows every thread and no notice.

The plus duplicates the active tab's exact view and makes the copy the active tab with focus in it. Tabs share the strip equally, fill it, shrink to a minimum width and then scroll, by one rule at every width including the floor, keeping the active tab in view and the plus reachable, as decided on BPR-1206 under the owner's delegation.
Comment never opens an unusable page. Without a current-head line it is unavailable and says why, or it takes a defined line, and the inline page never shows empty panels or actions that cannot act.

Every thread card, in Comments, in Discuss and beside the code, opens a context menu by right-click and by the context-menu key or Shift+F10, listing its actions and Classify as defect, or for a defect its verdicts and Reclassify. A defect's card shows its state and classification on a badge button that opens the same actions, and Previous and Next defect with the position sit beside Next new comment. The tray's second tab holds none of these, every control dispatches the same core defect command as before, and RFC-BPR-0009's defect courses pass unchanged.

Dif is not in the right drawer. On every workbench surface without a prime spot he rests at 40 pixels in the status bar's corner with no pointer or focus path, stepping aside for transient messages; the signed-out first-time Home and BPR-0966's Compose workshop slot are his prime spots, and the one-sprite rule holds. Each RFC-BPR-0031 cue plays where he is with its unchanged trigger, the placement courses follow RFC-BPR-0031's owner amendment with a negative control, and BPR-0800 closes on this evidence.

The Notes tab lists the pull request's private notes from the existing ledger, and the reviewer writes, edits and deletes a note on the pull request or the current file through the existing ledger port. Promote to draft on a note or a selected side-chat reply creates a local draft at Comment's target with the item's text, keeps the source and publishes nothing before the explicit Publish; findings keep RFC-BPR-0012's conversions, and a composed course shows zero GitHub mutation, with a negative control.

Each slice's focused Qt and composed courses pass with negative controls on the exact candidate, renders at 100, 125 and 200 percent are inspected where the chrome changes, and the documentation gate passes. Each card's owner question on macOS is asked on its own and stays pending until supplied.
